title: Entra device records with no Intune record

report.title: {Items.Count} Entra {Plural(Items.Count, 'device has', 'devices have')} no Intune record

messages.businessImpact: These machines hold a directory identity and may hold access, while being managed by nothing.
remediation: Establish whether they should be enrolled, and enrol or remove them accordingly.
messages.cannotSee: Both lists are matched on the Entra device identifier, so an Intune record that carries none is left out rather than counted as orphaned. Why a machine holds a directory identity and no Intune record is not visible: it may never have enrolled, may have been retired from Intune while its directory record stayed, or may be managed by something else entirely. Entra reports the last sign-in approximately and sometimes not at all, so an empty activity column is an unknown rather than a device nobody has used.
